title: 5 Countries Where ChatGPT Is Blocked or Was Banned
hook: Think only far-off countries block ChatGPT? One of them is in Europe.

items.name: Italy
items.line: Italy blocked ChatGPT for about four weeks in 2023 over data privacy, then blocked China's DeepSeek in 2025.

items.name: Syria
items.line: Syria is still missing from OpenAI's list of supported countries, so ChatGPT won't work there.

items.name: Iran
items.line: Iran is also off OpenAI's list, so people there can't officially sign up for ChatGPT.

items.name: China
items.line: China doesn't get ChatGPT either, and since 2023 its public chatbots need a government security review.

items.name: North Korea
items.line: In North Korea, most people can't reach the global internet at all, just a government intranet.

outro: Should countries ever block AI apps? Tell me below.
description: Five countries where ChatGPT is blocked, unavailable or was temporarily banned: Italy's 2023 privacy block (lifted after about four weeks) and its 2025 DeepSeek block, countries missing from OpenAI's supported list, China's 2023 generative AI rules, and North Korea's closed intranet.
sources: China Interim Measures for Generative AI (eff. Aug 15, 2023) https://www.loc.gov/item/global-legal-monitor/2023-07-18/china-generative-ai-measures-finalized/
